adjudication.rationale: The diff adds Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update/#destroy that do `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` (app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb). If no row matches, `host` is nil and `save_host` will call `host.host = ...` (or `host.destroy`), raising NoMethodError and returning a 500. The new spec (spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb) only asserts inheritance and never hits these actions, so this real crash path (and other action behavior) is untested and would ship green.
